title: quiet_check races parallel website npm installs
description:
`make check` runs `scripts/checks/quiet_check.py`, which fans out `lint-website`, `lint-md`, `astro-check`, `test-js`, and `verify-schema-types` in parallel. Each of those targets runs `cd website && npm install ...` against the same `website/node_modules` tree. On the merged `origin/master` branch this produced deterministic ENOENT / missing-module failures during a single `make check` run, including missing `eslint-visitor-keys`, missing `tinyglobby`, and broken `.bin/astro-check` symlinks. The root cause is the concurrent `npm install` mutation of the same directory, not the Java issue cleanup in this PR.

Repro:
1. Start from current `origin/master`.
2. Run `make check`.
3. Observe website-target failures from partially installed or concurrently rewritten `website/node_modules` contents.

Fix direction: serialize the website package install, or make the website checks share a single prepared install instead of each target running `npm install` independently.
